source.text_it: L’indice di capacità di carico di uno pneumatico è un numero di due o tre cifre seguito dalle lettere km/h, riportato sul suo fianco

records.localized_text: A tire's load index is a two- or three-digit number followed by km/h on its sidewall.

source.text_it: L’indice di velocità di uno pneumatico non viene indicato nel caso di pneumatici da utilizzare solo in gemello

records.localized_text: A speed index is not shown for tires intended only for dual fitting.

source.text_it: Sul fianco dello pneumatico viene indicato se si tratta di uno pneumatico da utilizzare senza camera d’aria

records.localized_text: The tire sidewall indicates whether it is intended for use without an inner tube.

source.text_it: Se sul fianco dello pneumatico compare la scritta M+S, significa che lo pneumatico è omologato a percorsi innevati o fangosi

records.localized_text: M+S on a tire sidewall means it is approved for snowy or muddy routes.

source.text_it: Sul fianco dello pneumatico viene indicato se si tratta di uno pneumatico da utilizzare con camera d’aria

records.localized_text: The tire sidewall indicates whether it is intended for use with an inner tube.

source.text_it: Dalle scritte che compaiono sul fianco dello pneumatico è possibile ricavare la settimana e l’anno di produzione dello pneumatico

records.localized_text: Markings on the tire sidewall reveal its production week and year.

source.text_it: Sul fianco dello pneumatico si può trovare la sigla TWI

records.localized_text: The marking TWI may appear on the tire sidewall.

source.text_it: La sigla TWI, posta sul fianco dello pneumatico, si trova in corrispondenza degli indicatori di usura

records.localized_text: TWI on the tire sidewall is located at the wear indicators.

source.text_it: Il diametro di calettamento del cerchio su cui montare lo pneumatico è in genere indicato in millimetri

records.localized_text: The rim mounting diameter for a tire is generally shown in millimetres.

source.text_it: La larghezza nominale di sezione di uno pneumatico è in genere indicata in pollici

records.localized_text: A tire's nominal section width is generally shown in inches.

source.text_it: Se sul fianco dello pneumatico compare la scritta M+S, significa che lo pneumatico è da utilizzarsi su veicoli che trainano un rimorchio

records.localized_text: M+S on a tire sidewall means it is for vehicles towing a trailer.

source.text_it: Sul fianco dello pneumatico si può trovare la sigla MCTC se è stato omologato in Italia

records.localized_text: MCTC may appear on a tire sidewall if it was approved in Italy.

source.text_it: La sigla TWI, posta sul fianco dello pneumatico, si trova in corrispondenza della valvola di gonfiaggio

records.localized_text: TWI on the tire sidewall is located at the inflation valve.

source.text_it: La sigla TWI posta sul fianco dello pneumatico indica che si tratta di uno pneumatico da usare in gemello

records.localized_text: TWI on the tire sidewall indicates that the tire is intended for dual fitting.

source.text_it: Dalle scritte che compaiono sul fianco dello pneumatico non è possibile ricavarne la marca

records.localized_text: Tire sidewall markings cannot reveal the brand.

source.text_it: I tipi di pneumatici utilizzabili sul veicolo sono indicati sulla carta di circolazione

records.localized_text: The tire types usable on the vehicle are listed on the registration document.

source.text_it: Gli pneumatici dello stesso asse devono essere dello stesso tipo

records.localized_text: Tires on the same axle must be of the same type.

source.text_it: Gli pneumatici del veicolo possono essere di tipi differenti, purché uguali sullo stesso asse

records.localized_text: Vehicle tires may be of different types provided those on the same axle match.

source.text_it: Due ruote che montano cerchi diversi possono avere la stessa circonferenza di rotolamento

records.localized_text: Two wheels with different rims may have the same rolling circumference.

source.text_it: Il complesso pneumatico-cerchio non deve sporgere lateralmente dalla sagoma originale del veicolo

records.localized_text: The tire-rim assembly must not project sideways beyond the vehicle's original outline.

source.text_it: Le caratteristiche dimensionali degli pneumatici che sono montati sul veicolo non possono essere diverse da quelle riportate sulla carta di circolazione

records.localized_text: The dimensions of fitted tires may not differ from those on the registration document.

source.text_it: Su ogni veicolo può essere utilizzato un solo tipo di pneumatico

records.localized_text: Only one tire type may be used on each vehicle.

source.text_it: La marca di pneumatici utilizzabili sul veicolo è indicata sulla carta di circolazione

records.localized_text: The tire brands usable on the vehicle are listed on the registration document.

source.text_it: Gli pneumatici montati sullo stesso asse devono essere di tipo diverso

records.localized_text: Tires mounted on the same axle must be of different types.

source.text_it: Gli pneumatici dell’asse motore sono contraddistinti dalla sigla TRACT

records.localized_text: Drive-axle tires are identified by TRACT.

rows.text: The load index is a numerical code corresponding to a load capacity; speed is indicated by a separate symbol, not by km/h after the index.
evidence: UNECE Regulation 54 §§2.27–2.28, 3.1 and Annex 3, https://unece.org/fileadmin/DAM/trans/main/wp29/wp29regs/r054r2e.pdf: load indices, speed symbols, size, snow, tubeless, date and manufacturer markings.

rows.text: A speed category symbol is also marked for dual fitment; the load indices distinguish the fitting conditions.
evidence: UNECE Regulation 54 §§2.27–2.28, 3.1 and Annex 3, https://unece.org/fileadmin/DAM/trans/main/wp29/wp29regs/r054r2e.pdf: load indices, speed symbols, size, snow, tubeless, date and manufacturer markings.

rows.text: The TUBELESS marking identifies a tyre designed for use without an inner tube.
evidence: UNECE Regulation 54 §§2.27–2.28, 3.1 and Annex 3, https://unece.org/fileadmin/DAM/trans/main/wp29/wp29regs/r054r2e.pdf: load indices, speed symbols, size, snow, tubeless, date and manufacturer markings.

rows.text: M+S identifies a snow tyre: it is designed to improve traction in snow compared with a normal tyre.
evidence: UNECE Regulation No. 54 §§2.2 and 3.1.5, https://unece.org/fileadmin/DAM/trans/main/wp29/wp29regs/r054r2e.pdf: defines snow tyre by performance in snow and requires the M+S inscription for a snow tyre.

rows.text: The sidewall can indicate the type: for example, TUBE TYPE identifies a tyre designed for use with an inner tube.
evidence: Nexxus, Truck and Bus Tire Basics, Sidewall Marking Guide item 7, https://nexxustires.com/nexxus-truck-and-bus-tire-basics/: TUBE TYPE (TT) on the illustrated truck tyre identifies a tyre designed for an inner tube; example, not a universal mandatory marking.

rows.text: The manufacturing code gives the week and year: in the four-digit code the first two digits give the week and the last two the year.
evidence: UNECE Regulation 54 §§2.27–2.28, 3.1 and Annex 3, https://unece.org/fileadmin/DAM/trans/main/wp29/wp29regs/r054r2e.pdf: load indices, speed symbols, size, snow, tubeless, date and manufacturer markings.

rows.text: TWI can appear on the sidewall to help locate the tread wear indicators.
evidence: Michelin, Motorcycle tyre tread depth, https://africa.michelin.com/en/motorbike/advice-motorbike/tyre-basics/motorcycle-tyre-tread-depth-legal-limit: TWI can mark the position of tread wear indicators.

rows.text: TWI marks where to find the indicators on the tread that show wear in the grooves.
evidence: Michelin, Motorcycle tyre tread depth, https://africa.michelin.com/en/motorbike/advice-motorbike/tyre-basics/motorcycle-tyre-tread-depth-legal-limit: TWI can mark the position of tread wear indicators.

rows.text: In the usual marking the nominal rim diameter is generally given in inches, not millimetres.
evidence: Continental, Tire markings, https://www.continental-tires.com/tire-knowledge/tire-markings/: section width in mm, aspect ratio and rim diameter in inches.

rows.text: In the usual marking the nominal section width is generally given in millimetres, not inches.
evidence: Continental, Tire markings, https://www.continental-tires.com/tire-knowledge/tire-markings/: section width in mm, aspect ratio and rim diameter in inches.

rows.text: M+S identifies a snow tyre, not a requirement concerning towing a trailer.
evidence: UNECE Regulation 54 §§2.27–2.28, 3.1 and Annex 3, https://unece.org/fileadmin/DAM/trans/main/wp29/wp29regs/r054r2e.pdf: load indices, speed symbols, size, snow, tubeless, date and manufacturer markings.

rows.text: International approval is shown by a circled E and the country number, not by MCTC; Italy’s number is 3.
evidence: UN Regulation 54 §4.4 and Annex 2, https://eur-lex.europa.eu/eli/reg/2008/54%282%29/oj/eng: approval mark is circled E and country number, plus approval number; Italy is 3.

rows.text: TWI locates the tread wear indicators, not the inflation valve.
evidence: Michelin, Motorcycle tyre tread depth, https://africa.michelin.com/en/motorbike/advice-motorbike/tyre-basics/motorcycle-tyre-tread-depth-legal-limit: TWI can mark the position of tread wear indicators.

rows.text: TWI refers to tread wear indicators; it does not indicate dual fitment.
evidence: Michelin, Motorcycle tyre tread depth, https://africa.michelin.com/en/motorbike/advice-motorbike/tyre-basics/motorcycle-tyre-tread-depth-legal-limit: TWI can mark the position of tread wear indicators.

rows.text: The manufacturer’s trade name or brand is among the sidewall markings, so the brand can be identified.
evidence: UNECE Regulation 54 §§2.27–2.28, 3.1 and Annex 3, https://unece.org/fileadmin/DAM/trans/main/wp29/wp29regs/r054r2e.pdf: load indices, speed symbols, size, snow, tubeless, date and manufacturer markings.

rows.text: The registration document records permitted sizes, including any alternatives: compare these details with the tyre markings.
evidence: MIT circular 25978, 22 October 2013, https://www.mit.gov.it/nfsmitgov/files/media/normativa/2016-02/Circolare_protocollo_25978_22-10-2013_all_1.pdf: alternative tyre sizes can be recorded on registration document.

rows.text: Tyres normally fitted to the same axle must be of the same type, rather than being chosen independently for each side.
evidence: UN Regulation 142 §§5.2.1.1–5.2.1.2, https://eur-lex.europa.eu/eli/reg/2021/1366/oj/eng: normal tyres on one axle same type; all normal tyres same structure.

rows.text: Different axles may have different types, provided those on the same axle are the same type; normally fitted tyres must still have the same structure.
evidence: UN Regulation 142 §§5.2.1.1–5.2.1.2, https://eur-lex.europa.eu/eli/reg/2021/1366/oj/eng: normal tyres on one axle same type; all normal tyres same structure.

rows.text: Rim diameter alone does not determine rolling circumference: a different sidewall height can compensate for the difference in rim size.
evidence: Continental, Tire markings, https://www.continental-tires.com/tire-knowledge/tire-markings/: section width in mm, aspect ratio and rim diameter in inches.

Directive 97/24/EC, consolidated Annex II §1.34, https://eur-lex.europa.eu/legal-content/EN/TXT/PDF/?uri=CELEX%3A01997L0024-20060908: theoretical rolling circumference depends on tyre overall diameter; section height can offset rim diameter.

rows.text: The quiz marks this TRUE. For alternative tyres, a 1996 ministry circular called for checking that the vehicle’s maximum dimensions remained unchanged and that wider tyres did not extend beyond the body. Choose permitted sizes and check the applicable requirements: this source does not establish a universal rule for every part of the rim and every original outline.
evidence: Official superiori bank question 30056, p. 125, printed VERO, asserts tyre-rim assembly must not protrude laterally past original outline.

Italian Ministry circular 94/96, 20 June 1996, https://www.automotoradriatica.com/wp-content/2011/Download/circolare-94_96.PDF — historical inspection of certain alternative tyres: unchanged maximum vehicle dimensions; wider tyres not beyond body; M3/N3 expressly distinguished for rim-diameter condition. Its scope does not establish a blanket prohibition on every rim edge beyond the original silhouette.

Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2021/535 Annex V Part 2, https://eur-lex.europa.eu/eli/reg_impl/2021/535/oj/eng — type-approval wheel-guard geometry within specified scope, not independent proof of a universal whole-wheel original-outline rule.

rows.text: Fitted sizes must match those authorized for the vehicle and recorded in its registration documents; a different size requires the applicable approval procedure.
evidence: MIT circular 25978, 22 October 2013, https://www.mit.gov.it/nfsmitgov/files/media/normativa/2016-02/Circolare_protocollo_25978_22-10-2013_all_1.pdf: alternative tyre sizes can be recorded on registration document.

rows.text: There is not necessarily only one type: alternative sizes and different types on different axles may be permitted, subject to fitment requirements.
evidence: UN Regulation 142 §§5.2.1.1–5.2.1.2, https://eur-lex.europa.eu/eli/reg/2021/1366/oj/eng: normal tyres on one axle same type; all normal tyres same structure.

MIT circular 25978, 22 October 2013, https://www.mit.gov.it/nfsmitgov/files/media/normativa/2016-02/Circolare_protocollo_25978_22-10-2013_all_1.pdf: alternative tyre sizes can be recorded on registration document.

rows.text: The registration document records specifications such as permitted sizes, not a required tyre brand; the brand appears on the sidewall.
evidence: MIMS, Quesiti Ispettore Revisioni Modulo B, 17 February 2022, question B1E264, https://www.dgtno.it/wp-content/uploads/2022/05/Quesiti_IspettoreRevisioni_Mod_B_MIMS_17_02_2022.pdf: EU rules do not prescribe the tyre maker’s brand on the registration document.

MIT circular 25978, 22 October 2013, https://www.mit.gov.it/nfsmitgov/files/media/normativa/2016-02/Circolare_protocollo_25978_22-10-2013_all_1.pdf: alternative tyre sizes can be recorded on the document.
UNECE Regulation No. 54 §3.1.1, https://unece.org/fileadmin/DAM/trans/main/wp29/wp29regs/r054r2e.pdf: manufacturer name or trade mark is marked on the tyre.

rows.text: Tyres normally fitted on the same axle must be the same type, not different types.
evidence: UN Regulation 142 §§5.2.1.1–5.2.1.2, https://eur-lex.europa.eu/eli/reg/2021/1366/oj/eng: normal tyres on one axle same type; all normal tyres same structure.

rows.text: TRACT is not a code identifying every drive-axle tyre. For example, Michelin uses D for a tread pattern designed for the stresses on drive axles, which transmit engine and braking torque.
evidence: Michelin, Truck and bus tyre marking and basics, drive axle section, https://b2b.middle-east.michelin.com/help-advice/truck/truck-bus-tyre-marking-and-basics: Michelin D tread patterns are designed for drive-axle stresses including engine and braking torque; Z patterns can also be fitted on drive axles.
UNECE Regulation No. 54 §3.1, https://unece.org/fileadmin/DAM/trans/main/wp29/wp29regs/r054r2e.pdf: prescribed markings do not specify TRACT as a universal drive-axle marking.

reviewer_evidence: Independently inspected Ministry circular 94/96 https://www.automotoradriatica.com/wp-content/2011/Download/circolare-94_96.PDF: historical alternative tyre approval, unchanged dimensions and tyre within body; 30056 correctly states source limitations. UN R142 https://eur-lex.europa.eu/legal-content/EN/TXT/?toc=OJ%3AL%3A2021%3A293%3AFULL&uri=uriserv%3AOJ.L_.2021.293.01.0034.01.ENG indexed §§5.2.1.1–2 inspected. UNECE R54 direct legacy host returned 403; independently inspected official EU 2008 publication https://eur-lex.europa.eu/legal-content/EN/TXT/PDF/?uri=CELEX:42008X0711(01).

issues.reason: The official question asserts that the whole tyre-and-rim assembly must not project laterally beyond the original vehicle outline, for the superior-licence bank. The located specific original-outline provision applies to replacement wheel systems on passenger cars and refers to tyres, so it does not establish that full statement for heavier vehicles and rims. The wheel-guard rules establish coverage in a specified sector, not that original-outline limit. An applicable authority or adjudication of the intended scope is needed.
checked_sources: Official Domande Superiori, question 30056, https://www.ilportaledellautomobilista.it/documents/56611/85457073/DomandeSuperiori.pdf/7725566d-e40f-4583-ad74-db4395d103cf: prints VERO for the entire assembly and original vehicle outline.

Decreto 10 gennaio 2013 n. 20, Annex C §2.2.2.1, https://www.pneus.it/images/ruote-in-lega/decreto-10-gennaio-2013-n20.pdf: tyres must not protrude beyond original body profile in specified replacement wheel approval tests, limited to passenger cars.

Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2021/535 Annex V Part 2 §§2.1–2.2, https://eur-lex.europa.eu/eli/reg_impl/2021/535/oj/eng: wheel-guard coverage in a specified sector, not a general original-outline rule.

issues.reason: The cited Regulation 54 defines the snow tyre by better performance in snow, not the asserted comparative performance in mud, and the cited provisions do not support the severe-snow test distinction. Cite applicable authority for both claims or correct them in all languages.

The cited TT example is specifically for motorcycle tyres; it does not establish how the relevant commercial-vehicle tyre is marked for tube use. Supply an applicable authoritative source or qualify the explanation to avoid implying this example establishes a universal marking.

The cited wheel-guard provisions are in Annex V Part 2, not Annex IV. They concern coverage in a specified sector and do not establish the assertion about projection beyond the original vehicle outline for this bank; the explanation does not resolve that distinction. Cite applicable authority and explain the tested limit accurately.

The cited ministry circular establishes that alternative sizes may be recorded for imported vehicles, but does not establish the asserted general absence of a mandatory brand from registration documents. Provide an authoritative source for that claim.

The cited Michelin passage establishes FRT restrictions, not the asserted TRACT rule or a general requirement to follow the tyre manufacturer’s specified position. Regulation 54’s listed markings alone do not establish the latter. Provide an applicable source and explain what the drive-axle designation actually signifies.
